summary: Replayed ADR 0396 deterministic service decommissioning from an isolated worktree, live-applied the generated SLO and HTTPS/TLS marker assets through the governed Grafana monitoring path, verified Prometheus and deployed marker state end to end, and completed the restic live-apply backup hook.

verification.observed: `make live-apply-service service=grafana env=production ALLOW_IN_PLACE_MUTATION=true EXTRA_ARGS='-e bypass_promotion=true'` completed with `monitoring ok=254 changed=39 unreachable=0 failed=0 skipped=54 rescued=0 ignored=0`.
Direct Prometheus API verification found `slo_recording_rules` with 378 rules, `slo_alert_rules` with 126 rules, and `https_tls_assurance` with 165 rules.

The monitoring VM has balanced `# BEGIN SERVICE:` / `# END SERVICE:` blocks in `/etc/prometheus/rules/slo-rules.yml`, `/etc/prometheus/rules/slo-alerts.yml`, `/etc/prometheus/file_sd/slo-targets.yml`, `/etc/prometheus/rules/https-tls-alerts.yml`, and `/etc/prometheus/file_sd/https-tls-targets.yml`.
The live-apply wrapper completed the restic backup trigger with status `ok` and remote receipt `receipts/restic-backups/20260421T114502Z.json`.

notes: The first live-apply attempt was correctly blocked by a stale vulnerability-budget host scan; a host-only security posture refresh was recorded locally before `python3 scripts/vulnerability_budget.py --service grafana` approved the second attempt.

This workstream branch intentionally does not update `VERSION`, release sections in `changelog.md`, the top-level `README.md` integrated status summary, or `versions/stack.yaml`; those remain merge-to-main integration tasks.
